Sprint 6 C-SDLC v3 delivery/cutover status correction:

The prior #534 status comment was an advance-notice snapshot, not merge authority. Since that comment, PR #591 has received additional review-tail/evidence commits. Treat the prior exact head and CI text as stale snapshot evidence only.

Current rule for #505 / PR #591: perform fresh live GitHub readback of PR head, CI, mergeability, review, and closing linkage before any approval or merge decision. Until #505 is explicitly operator-approved, merged, and terminally reconciled, C-SDLC v2 remains live authority and C-SDLC v3 remains non-authoritative construction/cutover evidence.

A local v3 trial has now been run only as non-authoritative construction proof: `csdlc-v3-local` consumed repo-contained #505 request/registry/registration fixtures, emitted `read_only: true`, `operational_authority: false`, planned `SIP -> STP -> SPP -> VPP -> SRP -> SOR`, and reached `doctor_ready`. This did not create a GitHub issue, bind live lifecycle authority, publish, finish, clean, or cut over from v2.
